title: Concept: cookie without HttpOnly
description: A cookie without HttpOnly is readable by JavaScript on the origin, so any script injection can copy the session and keep using it after the injection is fixed. The flag does not prevent cross-site scripting; it removes cookie theft as the most valuable payoff.
applicability: Any response whose Set-Cookie values are inspected.
risk: Script-readable session cookie; LOW severity alone, higher for authentication cookies.
